limitations: Six recordings are three calibration sessions from one participant/device, not six independent participants.
Actual glyph/word geometry is absent; no offset-only exact-word accuracy is reported.
Reconstruction is validated on every measured base/effective line assignment; no target stabilization is replayed.
Original gain/bias arm uses its original acceptance decision. OFF arms are simulated only; a rejected original fit leaves that arm at identity.
No raw device trace is stored in this artifact. Newer source files remain app-private on the phone.
